detection.note: Yellow paper plant detection: H(20-32)=pure yellow only, S(80+)=vivid colors only, V(60+)=bright regions. Excludes green plants and shadows.

periodic_capture.note: Captures full-resolution images at regular intervals during mission

pixhawk.note: TELEM2 at 921600 baud (high-speed). read_only=false allows detection transmission to GCS.

mavlink_command_receiver.note: DISABLED - Conflicts with dronekit's message receiver. Use Socket.IO for Pi control instead.

mavlink_detection.description: Hybrid detection transmission - Socket.IO primary + MAVLink fallback
mavlink_detection.note: Enables detection transmission over long-range MAVLink radio via Pixhawk to GCS. Messages forwarded from TELEM2 to TELEM1 automatically.

safety.note: min_altitude reduced to 0.5m to allow landing. Geofence checks are automatically disabled during RTL/LAND modes.

socketio.note: Socket.IO connection settings. ping_timeout=60s prevents disconnections on slow networks. ping_interval=25s keeps connection alive.
